senses.gloss:
शिशिर a. [शश्-किरच् नि.
Uṇ. 1. 53] Cool, cold, chill, frigid;
कुरु यदुनंदनचदनशिशिरतरेण करेण
[]
पयोधरे Gīt. 12; R. 14. 3, 16. 49.
--रः, --रं
1 Dew, hoar-frost; पझानां
शिशिराद्भयं; जातां मन्ये शिशिरमथितां पद्मिनीं
वान्यरूपां Me. 83.
--2 The cold season
(comprising the two months Māgha
and Phālguna); कंठेषु स्खलितं गतेऽपि
शिशिरे पुंस्कोकिलानां रुतं Ś. 6. 3,
Pt. 1. 128
--3 Coldness, frigidity.
--Comp.
--अंशुः, --करः, --किरणः, --दीधितिः, --रश्मिः
the moon; बुव इव शिशिरांशोः
V. 5. 21; शिशिरकिरणकांतं वासरातेऽभिसार्य
Śi. 11. 21; शिशिरदीधितिना रजन्यः
Rs. 3. 2.
--अत्ययः, --अपगमः ‘the close of
the cold season’, the spring season;
स्वहस्तलूनः शिशिरात्ययस्य (पुष्पच्चियः)
Ku. 3. 61; उपहित शिशिरापगमश्रिया
R. 9. 31.
--कालः, --समयः the cold season.
--घ्नः an epithet of Agni.

शिशुः [शो-कु सन्वद्भावः द्वित्वम्; cf.
Uṇ. 1. 20]
1 A child, an infant; शिशुर्वा
शिष्या वा U. 4. 11.
--2 The young
of any animal (as a calf, puppy,
fawn &c.); Ś. 1. 15; 7. 14, 18.
--3
A boy under eight or sixteen years
of age.
--4 A pupil, scholar.
--Comp.
--क्रंदः, --क्रंदनं the cry or weeping of
a child.
--क्रंदीयः (i. e. ग्रथः) a
work treating of the complaints of
children.
--गंधा a kind of jasmine
(double jasmine).
--चाद्रायणं a
lunar penance of children; (चतुरः
प्रातरश्नीयींत्पडान् विप्रः समाहितः । चतुरोऽ
स्तमिते सूर्ये शिशुचांद्रायणं स्मृतं ॥
Ms. 11. 220).
--नागः a young elephant.
--पालः N. of a king of the Cedis
and son of Damaghoṣa. [According
to the Viṣṇu Purāṇa this monarch was,
in a previous existence, the
unrighteous Hiraṇyakaśipu, king of the Asuras
who was killed by Viṣṇu in the form
of Narasiṃha. He was next born as
the ten-he added Rāvaṇa who was killed
by Rāma. Then he was born as the
son of Damaghoṣa, and continued his
enmity to Kṛṣṇa, the eighth
incarnation of Viṣṇu, with even greater
implacability; (see Śi. 1.) He
denounced Kṛṣṇa when they met at the
Rajasuya sacrifice of Yudhiṣṭhira, but his
head was cut off by Kṛṣṇa with his
discus. His death forms the subject
of a celebrated poem by Māgha].
˚हन् m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
--मारः the Gangetic porpoise. ˚शिरसु
n. the northeast quarter.
--वाहकः,
वाह्यकः a wild goat.
--हत्या
childmurder, infanticide.

1 A child, an infant.
--2
The young of any animal.
--3 A
[]
tree.
--4 A porpoise.
--5 A fish
resembling a porpoise.

शिशुलः Ved.
1 A child.
--2 The
young of an animal.

शिश्नं, शिस्तं [शअ-नक् नि.] The
penis or male organ of generation;
Y. 1. 17; Ms. 11. 105.
--Comp.
--देवः a lustful or unchaste man
(sporting with the penis).

शिश्नं, शिस्तं [शअ-नक् नि.] The
penis or male organ of generation;
Y. 1. 17; Ms. 11. 105.
--Comp.
--देवः a lustful or unchaste man
(sporting with the penis).

शिशिवदान a.
1 Pious in
conduct, virtuous, holy.
--2 Wicked,
sinful.

शिष् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (शेषति) To hurt,
kill. {vII.v} {c1c} P., {c10c} U., (शेषति,
शेषयति-ते) To leave as a remainder,
spare. {vIII.v} {c7c} P. (शिनष्टि, शिष्ट)
1
To leave as a remainder, leave,
leave remaining.
--2 To distinguish
or discriminate from others. --Caus.
(शेषयति-ते) To leave &c.

शिष्ट p. p. [शास् क्त शिष-क्त वा]
1
Left, remaining^1, residual, rest.
--2
Ordered, commanded.
--3 Trained,
educated, disciplined.
--4 Tamed,
docile, tractable.
--5 Wise, learned;
Śi. 2. 10; Pt. 1. 234.
--6
Virtuous, respectable.
--7 Civil, polite.
--8 Chief, principal, superior,
excellent, distinguished, eminent;
R. 1. 28.
--ष्ट्रः
1 An eminent or
distinguished person.
--2 A wise
man.
--3 A counsellor.
--Comp.
--आचारः {1} the practice of wise
men. {2} good manners, good
breeding.
--सभा an assembly of chief
or learned men, a council of state.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210122. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48.

शिष्टिः f. [शास्-क्तिन्]
1 Rule,
government.
--2 Order, command.
--3 Chastisement, punishment.

शिष्यः [शस् --क्यप्]
1 A pupil,
disciple, scholar; शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मा
त्वां प्रपन्नं Bg. 2. 7.
--2 Anger, passion^1.
--3 Violence, force.
--Comp.
--परंपरा a
succession of pupils.
--पुत्रः a pupil
regarded as a son.
--शिष्ट्रिः f. the
correction of a pupil.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk on 20210104. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20.
